sweep: certification, 8 x 1250 games, seeds 2000000 + k*100000 (k=0..7), strict matcher, --repros-per-game 40 --keep-repro 1000, --checkpoint per shard
seed_registry: validated against the private seed registry (26 protected bands, 13 reservation files); this sweep's own reservation filed as engine-cert-sweep-20260730 before launch
per_shard_gates: wheel REBUILT per shard venv (the #941 blind-spot rule) + scripts/engine_behavioral_probes.py 9/9 in-shard before measuring; any probe failure disqualifies the shard

acceptance_criterion.binding: ZERO UNATTRIBUTED ROWS: every divergent row must classify to a documented limit class or, on replay-first triage, to a documented adjudicated family (reports/c12_decomposition.json families as amended by Z10/Z11). Any row not attributable = SWEEP FAILURE, reported not absorbed.
acceptance_criterion.achievable_bar: documented limit classes and adjudicated instrument/limit-shape families at their predicted rates; engine_errors == 0; measured_fraction_of_full_rounds reported alongside
acceptance_criterion.not_the_bar: raw zero diverged transitions - the comparison itself prices stochastic branch sets (Z11.4); the honest zero is zero UNEXPLAINED

notes: class counts at 300 games are small for the thin classes; Wilson intervals widen accordingly - the binding criterion is attribution, not per-class count matching
new SEEDS mean new rows; family attribution at readout is by signature (majority-miss shape, markers, replay), not by row identity
